record.original_question: Let C_a be the class of associative bivariate copulas, equivalently the 1-Lipschitz triangular norms, and let C_tilde_a be the closure, under uniform convergence, of all convex combinations of elements of C_a. Does C_tilde_a coincide exactly with the class of all bivariate copulas that are both Schur-concave and commutative?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\mathcal{C}$ denote the set of bivariate copulas, i.e., functions $C:[0,1]^2\to[0,1]$ such that $C(x,0)=C(0,y)=0$, $C(x,1)=x$, $C(1,y)=y$, and $C$ is 2-increasing: $C(x_2,y_2)-C(x_2,y_1)-C(x_1,y_2)+C(x_1,y_1)\ge 0$ for all $x_1\le x_2$, $y_1\le y_2$ in $[0,1]$.

A copula $C$ is called associative if $C(C(x,y),z)=C(x,C(y,z))$ for all $x,y,z\in[0,1]$; equivalently, $C$ is a 1-Lipschitz triangular norm. Let $\mathcal{C}_a$ denote the class of associative bivariate copulas.

A copula $C$ is called commutative if $C(x,y)=C(y,x)$ for all $x,y\in[0,1]$. It is called Schur-concave if $C(x,y)\le C(\lambda x+(1-\lambda)y,\lambda y+(1-\lambda)x)$ for all $x,y\in[0,1]$ and all $\lambda\in[0,1]$.

Let $\widetilde{\mathcal{C}}_a$ be the closure, under uniform convergence on $[0,1]^2$, of the set of all finite convex combinations of elements of $\mathcal{C}_a$. Determine whether $\widetilde{\mathcal{C}}_a$ coincides exactly with the class of all bivariate copulas that are both Schur-concave and commutative.
artifact.status_search_result: A recent preprint titled "Characterizing Schur-Concave Commutative Copulas as the Closure of Associative Ones" proves the affirmative answer: the uniform closure of convex combinations of associative copulas equals exactly the class of Schur-concave commutative copulas. The proof proceeds via checkerboard approximation, decomposition of symmetric shuffles, and the Birkhoff–von Neumann theorem, yielding an explicit approximation scheme.

status_evidence.title: Characterizing Schur-Concave Commutative Copulas as the Closure of Associative Ones
status_evidence.snippet: Theorem 1.2: 𝒞a¯ = 𝒞SC — the closure of the convex hull of associative copulas equals the class of Schur-concave commutative copulas.
